_: THE SWEEP THAT SAYS A MARKER PREFIX IS READ AND IS NOT PART OF THE ID — run it
WHAT THE CONTRACT IS. `inventory_marker_prefixes` declares prefixes that mark
an inventory citation inside a document — `req="REQ-4.2.1"` — and the id is
the tail alone. Registered as a path prefix, the same annotation kept its
syntax in the id, so an active entry read as missing and a deprecated one was
never reported. All three inventory axes are now read through one
`InventoryCitationAxes`, which the scan and the decay scan both take.
TWO INJECTIONS. Keeping the prefix in a marker id is the defect the axis exists
to remove; it must redden the extractor test, the three-axis test and the gate
run through the real binary. Dropping the marker axis from the one reader is
how a third list threaded beside the other two would have gone missing from one
caller; it must redden the three-axis test and the gate run.
RUN IT LOCALLY. The harness edits this tree and writes the firing record
